title: 15. Apply account transfers atomically

examples.explanation: missing target does not debit source

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your code in the function at the top of the editor. Follow the numbered steps and replace each TODO. Run checks the three examples. Submit checks all cases, including edge cases. Open the hints one at a time if you are stuck.

Keep the adapter class at the bottom unchanged. It reads the input, calls your function, and rejects changes to the input. Python 3.11 and the standard library.

hints: Check first, then change. If you subtract before you know that the target exists, a failed transfer loses money.
`ok = source in accounts and target in accounts and accounts[source] >= amount`.
Use `>=`, because an exact balance is enough. For a transfer to the same account, subtract then add gives the same balance.
